The Residence

The last plot in a fifty-acre township

Park Green is the final residential phase of Bukit Jalil City, the 50-acre freehold township Malton has been building out since 2017 — the one that already holds Pavilion Bukit Jalil, The Park 2, The Park Sky Residences and Hyatt Place.

Two towers of 47 storeys hold just 453 homes between them: six on a floor in Tower A, seven in Tower B, four lifts to each lobby. Every home is a three-bedroom or larger and starts at 1,201 sq ft — in an area where the three-bedroom norm sits closer to 900.

Several layouts face the 80-acre Bukit Jalil Recreational Park directly. The rest look over the facilities deck and Pavilion.

  • Freehold — rare on this side of Bukit Jalil
  • 350 m to the 80-acre Bukit Jalil Recreational Park
  • A dedicated pedestrian bridge to Pavilion Bukit Jalil
  • Two facility levels — the podium on Level 11, the sky deck on Level 47
  • 2 to 3 car parks with every home
  • GreenRE Certified (Provisional), residential category
Get the price list
The Connection

A mall you walk to, not one you live on top of.

Pavilion Bukit Jalil is 50 m away and reached on its own pedestrian bridge — so the retail is next door rather than underneath, and the residence keeps its own arrival court, lobby and concierge.

  • 50 mTo Pavilion Bukit Jalil — winner of the FIABCI World Prix d’Excellence Awards 2024 Gold Award in the retail category, and 1.8 million sq ft of retail space owned and managed by Pavilion REIT.
  • A private bridgeA dedicated pedestrian bridge runs from the development to the mall. The developer describes it as to be connected to the existing link-bridge — it is not open today.
  • Ground floorConcierge, waiting lounge, parcel room, mail room, a food delivery zone and EV charging, all off the grand drop-off.

Every type is three bedrooms or more, and every one comes with two car parks — three on the largest. Sizes below are the developer’s.

Tap a plan to enlarge. Tower A holds 210 homes at six per floor; Tower B holds 243 at seven. Living areas run up to 20 ft wide and every bedroom takes a queen bed. All homes are partially furnished — kitchen cabinet with hood and hob, air-conditioning, digital lockset, counter top and vanity, shower screens and a washer dryer; the bath tub and “his & hers” basins are Type E and F only.

Before You Ask

The questions that come up first

Persiaran Jalil Utama, next to Pavilion Bukit Jalil, inside the 50-acre Bukit Jalil City township. The developer publishes 50 m to Pavilion Bukit Jalil and 350 m to the 80-acre Bukit Jalil Recreational Park.

Regal Path Sdn Bhd, a subsidiary of Malton Berhad. Malton is the master developer of Bukit Jalil City and has been building the township out since 2017.

Yes — freehold, and the land use is serviced apartment rather than condominium. That is worth knowing because it affects utility tariffs and assessment rates.

453 homes across two 47-storey towers. Tower A holds 210 at six per floor; Tower B holds 243 at seven. Each tower lobby has four lifts.

In Tower A, Types D, E and F face Bukit Jalil Park. In Tower B, Type A1 faces Bukit Jalil and Type C is a corner facing it. The remaining types look over the facilities deck and Pavilion. Ask me which stacks are still open.

Not yet. The developer describes a dedicated pedestrian bridge to be connected to the existing link-bridge. It is part of the plan rather than something you can walk today, and this page will not pretend otherwise.

The price moves with remaining stock and the current launch package, so it is quoted personally rather than posted here. Message me and I’ll send the live price list, and confirm whether any discount or package applies to you.

To be confirmed — neither the brochure nor the developer’s project brief publishes a completion date, and no date has been estimated here. The same applies to the advertising permit and developer’s licence numbers.

Partially furnished: kitchen cabinet with cooking hood and hob in the wet kitchen, air-conditioning to the living area and all bedrooms, a digital lockset, a 2-in-1 washer dryer, counter tops and vanity cabinets to all bathrooms, shower screens with doors, and a storage water heater to the master bathroom. Type E and F also get a bath tub and “his & hers” basins.
